description: Synth clients: careful, precise, polite, used to being doubted. They state limits and risks openly.

s-hail: Thank you for coming. I know it was short notice.
Good day. I appreciate your time.
Captain. I'll be careful with my words.
I'm glad you looked at me, and not at my plating.
Hello. I hope you don't mind being asked.
Captain {captain}, I'll be as clear as I can.
Thank you for hearing me out.
I know how this looks, so let me start plainly.
s-intro: My name is {client}. I have papers if you want them.
I act for {faction}, and I can show you the authorisation.
I'm {client}. I've been careful about whom I ask.
{faction} has asked me to find someone steady.
I'm {client}. I'm not here to cause trouble, whatever you may have been told.
I work for {faction}. I'd rather say so than have you wonder.
s-frame: I'll set out what I know, and what I don't.
It's a straightforward request, I think.
I'd like to be exact about what's needed.
I'll explain it once and then answer questions.
I have a request, and some honesty about it.
It's not complicated, though it isn't nothing.
s-clock: The timing is {deadline}, as precisely as I can say it.
I have {deadline} to work with, and so do you.
I'd be grateful if it were done in {deadline}.
The window is {deadline}. I've checked it twice.
The deadline is {deadline}. I'm sorry it isn't longer.
s-clock2: Please tell me early if that won't work.
I'd rather hear about a delay than discover it.
I've allowed some margin, though not much.
I can't offer more time, I'm afraid.
s-stakes: People are depending on it, and I'd rather not guess how many.
A delay would be hard to explain, and harder to repair.
It matters more than the form suggests.
I've been careful so that it could be on time.
There's very little room for error.
I'm aware I'm asking a lot.
s-offer: You'll be paid {reward}, and I have it set aside.
{reward} on completion, which I hope is fair.
It pays {reward}. I'd like to say more, but that is accurate.
s-terms: I'll pay it promptly, and I'll provide a receipt.
The payment is documented and traceable.
I won't ask you to take it on trust.
I'll pay what I promised, in full.
I can show you the account first.
You'll receive it as soon as the work is verified.
s-extra: I'd also be glad to give a reference.
If it goes smoothly, there may be more such work.
I remember who treats me fairly.
s-caution: Please be careful. Not everyone will be kind.
You may be searched. I'm sorry.
There are risks I can't fully list.
Some will not like who hired you.
I can't promise the route is clear.
Not all of the people involved are honest.
There may be questions at ports.
s-caution2: I'm used to that, though I wouldn't wish it on you.
I'm telling you because you deserve to know.
s-conseq: If it goes wrong, I'll understand, but I may not be able to help.
I won't blame you, though others might.
If something changes, please tell me promptly.
I cannot protect you from the consequences, only warn you.
If you can't continue, say so before it's too late.
s-send: Thank you for not asking me to step aside.
s-part: I'll be hoping for the best.
Please contact me if anything is unclear.
I do appreciate being treated as a person.
Take as much care as I would.
I hope we can speak again.
